limitation: Retrieved AFTER the corpus window and filtered backwards by publish date. A version unpublished from the registry before retrieval cannot appear here even if it existed during the window, so absence is evidence, not proof.
note: Every version npm has published for these packages, with its publish date. Fetched once; the experiment reads this file and never the network. Cutoffs are applied downstream so that "never published" and "published after the window" stay distinguishable.
